quests.title: "Foamflower Fields"

dialogue.t: Dear visitors, welcome to the Foamflower Fields!
Although... right now, it seems to be nothing but a no-flower grass field... And all my Asha assistants are nowhere to be found...
So, if any of you have a knack for gardening, maybe you could give this place a much-needed splash of color!

quests.description: Head to the “Foamflower Fields” for some fun
